title: Characterizing the relationship between MRI radiomics and AHR expression and deriving a predictive model for prognostic assessment in glioblastoma.
authors: Liu, Chen; Xu, Dingkang; Meng, Limin; Li, Hongqi; Fu, Zhiguang; Yan, Maohui; Hu, Xiaolong; Wang, Yingjie
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用MRI影像组学预测胶质母细胞瘤中AHR表达及预后，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、转录因子结合或AI/物理模拟建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: PURPOSE: Aryl hydrocarbon receptor (AHR), a crucial molecular marker associated with glioma, is a potential therapeutic target. We aimed to establish a non-invasive predictive model for AHR through radiomics. METHODS: Contrast-enhanced T1-weighted (T1W) MRI and the corresponding and clinical variables of glioblastoma patients from The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA) and The Cancer Imaging Archive (TCIA) were obtained for analysis. KM curves and Cox regression analyses were used to assess the prognostic value of AHR expression. The radiomics features were screened by Max-Relevance and Min-Redundancy (mRMR) and recursive feature elimination (RFE), followed by the construction of two predictive models using logistic regression (LR) and a support vector machine (SVM). RESULTS: The expression levels of AHR in tumour patients were significantly higher than those in the control group, and higher AHR expression was associated with worse prognosis (P<0.05). AHR remained a risk factor for poor prognosis in glioblastoma after multivariate adjustment (HR: 1.61, 95% CI: 1.085-2.39, P<0.05). The radiomics models constructed using LR and SVM based on three selected features achieved area under the curve (AUC) values of 0.887 and 0.872, respectively. Radiomics score emerged as a key factor influencing overall survival (OS) after multivariate adjustment in the Cox model (HR: 3.931, 95% CI: 1.272-12.148, P < 0.05). CONCLUSION: The radiomics models could effectively distinguish the expression levels of AHR and predict prognosis in patients with glioblastoma, which may serve as a powerful tool to assist clinical assessment and precision treatment.
abstract_zh: 目的：芳香烃受体（AHR）是与胶质瘤相关的关键分子标志物，是潜在的治疗靶点。我们旨在通过影像组学建立AHR的无创预测模型。方法：从癌症基因组图谱（TCGA）和癌症影像档案库（TCIA）获取胶质母细胞瘤患者的对比增强T1加权（T1W）MRI及相应的临床变量进行分析。采用Kaplan-Meier曲线和Cox回归分析评估AHR表达的预后价值。通过最大相关性和最小冗余（mRMR）及递归特征消除（RFE）筛选影像组学特征，随后使用逻辑回归（LR）和支持向量机（SVM）构建两个预测模型。结果：肿瘤患者中AHR的表达水平显著高于对照组，且较高的AHR表达与较差的预后相关（P<0.05）。在多变量调整后，AHR仍是胶质母细胞瘤预后不良的风险因素（HR：1.61，95% CI：1.085-2.39，P<0.05）。基于三个选定特征使用LR和SVM构建的影像组学模型分别达到0.887和0.872的曲线下面积（AUC）值。在Cox模型的多变量调整后，影像组学评分成为影响总生存期（OS）的关键因素（HR：3.931，95% CI：1.272-12.148，P<0.05）。结论：影像组学模型能有效区分胶质母细胞瘤患者中AHR的表达水平并预测预后，可能作为辅助临床评估和精准治疗的强大工具。
